q: भारतीय अंग्रेजी लेखन में विशिष्ट योगदान के लिए अंग्रेजी भाषा का साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 किसने जीता?
e:
Former diplomat and author Navtej Sarna won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in English, while Mamta Kalia won it in Hindi for 'Jeete Jee Allahabad' (अंग्रेजी का साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 नवतेज सरना ने जीता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Sahitya Akademi Award was first instituted in 1954; R. K. Narayan won the first English Sahitya Akademi Award in 1960 for 'The Guide'.
2. Amitav Ghosh became the first English-language writer to receive the Jnanpith Award (54th, 2018).
3. Sahitya Akademi confers awards in 24 languages (22 Eighth Schedule + English & Rajasthani).
qe: Who won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in English for his distinguished contribution to Indian English writing?

q: 2026 के अकादमी पुरस्कारों (ऑस्कर) में सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म का ऑस्कर किस फिल्म ने जीता?
e:
'One Battle After Another' won Best Picture at the 2026 Oscars (ऑस्कर 2026 में 'वन बैटल आफ्टर अनदर' को सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म का पुरस्कार मिला)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Oscars are conferred by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS).
2. Satyajit Ray received an Honorary Academy Award for Lifetime Achievement in 1992.
3. A. R. Rahman won two Oscars in 2009 for 'Slumdog Millionaire'.
qe: Which film won the Best Picture Oscar at the 2026 Academy Awards?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शहर 'भारत की सांस्कृतिक राजधानी' कहलाता है और विश्व के सबसे प्राचीन निरंतर बसे नगरों में से एक है?
e:
Varanasi (Kashi / Banaras), situated on the crescent-shaped left bank of the Ganga, is celebrated as India's spiritual and cultural capital (वाराणसी को भारत की सांस्कृतिक राजधानी कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Varanasi is a UNESCO Creative City of Music (2015) and home to Banaras Hindu University (1916) and Kashi Vishwanath Corridor.
2. Sarnath (10 km from Varanasi) is where Gautam Buddha gave his first sermon.
3. Varanasi was designated the first Cultural and Tourism Capital of SCO (2022–23).
qe: Which city in Uttar Pradesh is known as the 'Cultural Capital of India' and is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की राजधानी लखनऊ के मध्य से कौन-सी नदी बहती है?
e:
Lucknow, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur are situated on the banks of the Gomti river, which originates from Fulhar Lake in Pilibhit district (लखनऊ गोमती नदी के तट पर बसा है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Lucknow is famous for Chikankari embroidery, Bara Imambara, Rumi Darwaza, and the Residency (1857).
2. CDRI (Central Drug Research Institute) and NBRI (National Botanical Research Institute) are located in Lucknow.
3. Lucknow was declared a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy / celebrated for Awadhi cuisine and Kathak (Lucknow Gharana).
qe: Which river flows through the heart of Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh?

q: फरवरी 1835 के अपने प्रसिद्ध विवरण-पत्र (Minute) के लिए किसे 'भारत में आधुनिक अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का जनक' कहा जाता है?
e:
Lord Macaulay's Minute (2 February 1835), approved by Governor-General Lord William Bentinck on 7 March 1835, made English the medium of higher instruction in India (लॉर्ड मैकाले के 1835 के मिनट से भारत में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा नीति लागू हुई)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Macaulay advocated the 'Downward Filtration Theory' (educating a small upper class who would filter knowledge down).
2. Jonathan Duncan founded the Sanskrit College at Banaras in 1791; Warren Hastings founded the Calcutta Madrasa in 1781.
3. Wood's Despatch (1854) later replaced Downward Filtration with mass education and universities at Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras (1857).
qe: Who is known as the 'Father of Modern English Education in India' for his famous Minute of February 1835?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत 6 से 14 वर्ष के बच्चों के लिए निःशुल्क एवं अनिवार्य शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार के रूप में सुनिश्चित किया गया है?
e:
Article 21A was inserted by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 and operationalized via the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009 (अनुच्छेद 21A शिक्षा के मौलिक अधिकार से संबंधित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. In Mohini Jain (1992) and Unni Krishnan (1993), the Supreme Court had earlier read Right to Education into Article 21.
2. RTE Act 2009 came into force across India on 1 April 2010.
3. Article 45 (DPSP) covers children below 6 years; Article 51A(k) makes it a Fundamental Duty of parents.
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is Free and Compulsory Education for children aged 6 to 14 years guaranteed as a Fundamental Right?

q: उत्तर-पश्चिमी भारत (मुख्यतः राजस्थान) में स्थित किस मरुस्थल को 'ग्रेट इंडियन डेजर्ट' भी कहा जाता है?
e:
The Thar Desert (spread across western Rajasthan and parts of Gujarat, Punjab, Haryana, and Pakistan) is the world's most densely populated desert (थार मरुस्थल को ग्रेट इंडियन डेजर्ट कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Luni is the only major seasonal river flowing through the Thar Desert (disappearing into the Rann of Kutch).
2. Indira Gandhi Canal (originating from Harike Barrage at Sutlej–Beas confluence) irrigates northwestern Rajasthan.
3. Desert National Park (Jaisalmer/Barmer) is the prime habitat of the critically endangered Great Indian Bustard (गोडावण).
qe: Which desert located in northwestern India (primarily Rajasthan) is also known as the 'Great Indian Desert'?

q: भारत का केंद्रीय बैंक कौन-सा है जो ₹1 के नोट व सिक्कों को छोड़कर सभी मुद्रा नोट जारी करने और मौद्रिक नीति के प्रबंधन के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
e:
The Reserve Bank of India (established 1 April 1935 on Hilton Young Commission's recommendation; HQ Mumbai) is India's central bank (भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक देश का केंद्रीय बैंक है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. ₹1 currency notes and all coins are issued by the Ministry of Finance (signed by the Finance Secretary), whereas ₹2 and above are issued by RBI (signed by the RBI Governor).
2. Sir Osborne Smith was the first RBI Governor; C. D. Deshmukh was the first Indian RBI Governor.
3. RBI was nationalized on 1 January 1949.
qe: Which institution is the central bank of India, responsible for issuing currency notes (except ₹1 notes and coins) and managing monetary policy?

q: किस पोषक तत्व की कमी घेंघा रोग (गले में थायरॉइड ग्रंथि के बढ़ने) का प्रमुख कारण है?
e:
Iodine is required by the thyroid gland to synthesize thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3); its deficiency causes Simple Goitre (आयोडीन की कमी से घेंघा रोग होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Universal Salt Iodization (using Potassium Iodate) prevents Iodine Deficiency Disorders (IDD).
2. Iron deficiency causes Anaemia; Calcium/Vitamin D deficiency causes Rickets/Osteomalacia.
3. Thyroid is the largest endocrine gland in the human body.
qe: Which nutrient deficiency is the primary cause of Goitre (enlargement of the thyroid gland in the neck)?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, 2026 एशियाई खेलों में महिला व्यक्तिगत गोल्फ स्वर्ण पदक किस भारतीय खिलाड़ी ने जीता?
e:
Pranavi Urs won the historic Women's Individual Golf Gold at the 2026 Asian Games on 3 October 2026 (प्रणवी उर्स ने 2026 एशियाई खेलों में गोल्फ स्वर्ण पदक जीता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. At the 2026 Asian Games, India also captured wrestling/boxing golds (Aman Sehrawat, Sujeet Kalkal, Lovlina Borgohain, Parveen Hooda, Ankush Panghal) and team golds in Cricket, Hockey, and Archery.
2. National Sports Day in India is celebrated on 29 August (Major Dhyan Chand's birth anniversary).
3. Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is India's highest sporting honour.
qe: In October 2026, which Indian athlete won the Women's Individual Golf Gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?

q: 26 नवंबर 2026 को STPI ने बरेली में अपना 75वाँ केंद्र खोला; इससे पूर्व 18 नवंबर 2026 को उत्तर प्रदेश के किस प्रमुख संस्थान ने 'AI कवच' लॉन्च किया?
e:
IIT Kanpur launched 'AI Kavach' on 18 November 2026 to strengthen AI-driven cybersecurity and digital resilience (18 नवंबर 2026 को आईआईटी कानपुर ने 'AI कवच' लॉन्च किया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. IIT Kanpur was established in 1959 and is a premier hub for AI, aerospace, and cybersecurity research (C3iHub).
2. STPI (Software Technology Parks of India) operates under MeitY.
3. UP Budget 2026–27 (10th full budget) targets ₹1,20,000 per capita income and 10 lakh youth jobs.
qe: On 26 November 2026, STPI opened its 75th centre in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh; earlier on 18 November 2026, which premier institute in UP launched 'AI Kavach'?

q: नवंबर 2026 में उद्धृत PLFS रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, भारत की बेरोजगारी दर 6.1% (2017–18) से घटकर 2023–24 में किस स्तर पर आ गई?
e:
India's unemployment rate declined from 6.1% in 2017–18 to 3.2% in 2023–24 as per PLFS data (बेरोजगारी दर 6.1% से घटकर 3.2% हो गई)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. PLFS (Periodic Labour Force Survey) is released by NSSO under MoSPI.
2. In parallel, India's Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) and female workforce participation showed steady upward trends.
3. Skill India Mission and PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) aim to enhance youth employability.
qe: According to the PLFS report cited in November 2026, India's unemployment rate declined from 6.1% (2017–18) to what level in 2023–24?

q: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से उत्तर प्रदेश का सबसे बड़ा जिला और सबसे छोटा जिला क्रमशः कौन-से हैं?
e:
Lakhimpur Kheri (~7,680 sq. km) is UP's largest district by area, and Hapur (~660 sq. km) is UP's smallest district by area (लखीमपुर खीरी सबसे बड़ा तथा हापुड़ सबसे छोटा जिला है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. By population (Census 2011): Prayagraj is the most populous district in UP, and Mahoba is the least populous district.
2. Lakhimpur Kheri houses Dudhwa National Park (UP's only National Park).
3. Uttar Pradesh is the 4th largest Indian state by area (after Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra).
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh has the largest geographical area, and which district has the smallest geographical area respectively?

q: 1887 में स्थापित उत्तर प्रदेश के किस प्रसिद्ध विश्वविद्यालय को ऐतिहासिक रूप से 'पूर्व का ऑक्सफोर्ड' (Oxford of the East) कहा जाता था?
e:
University of Allahabad (founded 23 September 1887, 4th oldest university in India after Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras) earned the sobriquet 'Oxford of the East' and was accorded Central University status in 2005 (इलाहाबाद विश्वविद्यालय को पूर्व का ऑक्सफोर्ड कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Uttar Pradesh has 6 Central Universities: University of Allahabad, BHU (Varanasi), AMU (Aligarh), BBAU (Lucknow), Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (Amethi), and Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (Jhansi).
2. Sir William Muir founded Muir Central College in 1872, which evolved into Allahabad University.
3. UPESSC (UP Education Service Selection Commission) is also headquartered in Prayagraj.
qe: Which famous university in Uttar Pradesh, founded in 1887, was historically celebrated as the 'Oxford of the East'?

q: 1784 में कलकत्ता में 'एशियाटिक सोसाइटी ऑफ बंगाल' के संस्थापक कौन थे, जिन्होंने कालिदास के 'अभिज्ञानशाकुन्तलम्' का अंग्रेजी अनुवाद (1789) किया?
e:
Sir William Jones founded the Asiatic Society of Bengal on 15 January 1784 (during Warren Hastings's tenure) and translated Shakuntala (1789) and Manusmriti (सर विलियम जोन्स ने एशियाटिक सोसाइटी की स्थापना की)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Charles Wilkins translated the Bhagavad Gita into English (1785, preface by Warren Hastings) and Hitopadesha.
2. James Prinsep deciphered Ashoka's Brahmi and Kharosthi inscriptions in 1837.
3. This Orientalist movement sparked immense European interest in Sanskrit and Indian literature (influencing Romantic poets too).
qe: Who was the founder of the 'Asiatic Society of Bengal' in Calcutta in 1784, who translated Kalidasa's 'Abhijnanashakuntalam' into English (1789)?

q: 1913 में सैन फ्रांसिस्को (अमेरिका) में सोहन सिंह भकना की अध्यक्षता में 'गदर पार्टी' की स्थापना किस क्रांतिकारी ने की थी?
e:
Lala Hardayal was the key ideologue and founder of the Ghadar Party (1913, HQ Yugantar Ashram, San Francisco), publishing the weekly paper 'Ghadar' (लाला हरदयाल गदर पार्टी के संस्थापक थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Shyamji Krishna Varma founded 'India House' in London (1905) and published 'The Indian Sociologist'.
2. Madam Bhikaji Cama ('Mother of Indian Revolution') unfurled the first version of the Indian flag at Stuttgart, Germany in 1907.
3. Komagata Maru incident (1914) involved a Japanese steamship carrying Indian passengers denied entry to Vancouver, Canada.
qe: Which revolutionary freedom fighter founded the 'Ghadar Party' in San Francisco (USA) in 1913 with Sohan Singh Bhakna as its first President?

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अंतर्गत पूर्व-प्राथमिक से माध्यमिक स्तर तक 100% सकल नामांकन अनुपात (GER) तथा उच्च शिक्षा में 50% GER प्राप्त करने के लक्ष्य वर्ष क्रमशः कौन-से हैं?
e:
NEP 2020 targets 100% GER in school education (pre-school to Grade 12) by 2030 and 50% GER in higher education by 2035 (स्कूली शिक्षा 2030 तथा उच्च शिक्षा 2035)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. NEP 2020 is India's third National Education Policy (after 1968 and 1986, modified 1992).
2. NIPUN Bharat Mission (2021) aims for Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) for every child by Grade 3.
3. PM SHRI (PM Schools for Rising India) upgrades 14,500+ schools as NEP 2020 exemplar schools.
qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what is the target year for achieving 100% Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) from pre-school to secondary level, and 50% GER in higher education respectively?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद राज्यसभा द्वारा उपस्थित व मतदान करने वाले सदस्यों के दो-तिहाई बहुमत से प्रस्ताव पारित होने पर संसद को 'राष्ट्रीय हित' में राज्य सूची के विषय पर कानून बनाने का अधिकार देता है?
e:
Article 249 is an exclusive special power of the Rajya Sabha, authorizing Parliament to legislate on a State List subject in the national interest for up to 1 year at a time (अनुच्छेद 249 राज्यसभा की विशेष शक्ति है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Another exclusive power of Rajya Sabha: Article 312 (creating new All-India Services by 2/3rd majority).
2. Article 250 applies during a National Emergency; Article 252 applies when two or more states request Parliament; Article 253 covers implementing international treaties.
3. Rajya Sabha cannot vote on Demands for Grants (exclusive to Lok Sabha).
qe: Which Article of the Constitution of India empowers the Parliament to make laws on any matter in the State List in the 'national interest' if the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution by a two-thirds majority of members present and voting?

q: भारत का कौन-सा राज्य केवल एक अन्य भारतीय राज्य (पश्चिम बंगाल) के साथ सीमा साझा करता है, जबकि नेपाल, चीन और भूटान के साथ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा साझा करता है?
e:
Sikkim borders ONLY West Bengal internally (and Meghalaya borders ONLY Assam internally), while Sikkim shares international borders with three countries—Nepal, Bhutan, and China (सिक्किम केवल पश्चिम बंगाल से सीमा साझा करता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Tripura is surrounded on three sides by Bangladesh ('Zero Line').
2. Sikkim became India's 22nd state in 1975 via the 36th Constitutional Amendment Act, and is India's first 100% Organic State (2016).
3. Uttar Pradesh borders the maximum number of Indian states/UTs (8 states + Delhi = 9).
qe: Which Indian state is the ONLY state in India that shares borders with just ONE other Indian state (West Bengal), while sharing international borders with Nepal, China (Tibet), and Bhutan?

q: आरबीआई की मौद्रिक नीति में 'रेपो दर' और 'बैंक दर' के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Repo Rate is for short-term collateralized lending; Bank Rate is for long-term/penal non-collateralized lending
Repo Rate is set by SEBI; Bank Rate is set by Finance Ministry
Bank Rate is always lower than Reverse Repo Rate
Repo Rate applies only to agricultural loans
e:
Repo Rate is the short-term rate (usually overnight to 14 days) with government securities as collateral (repurchase agreement), whereas Bank Rate is the long-term discount/penal rate without collateral (रेपो दर अल्पकालिक प्रतिभूति-युक्त व बैंक दर दीर्घकालिक/दंडात्मक दर है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. MSF (Marginal Standing Facility) rate is normally aligned with the Bank Rate (upper bound of the LAF corridor).
2. SDF (Standing Deposit Facility, introduced in 2022) acts as the floor of the LAF corridor without collateral.
3. Quantitative tools: CRR, SLR, Repo, OMO; Qualitative tools: Margin requirements, Moral suasion, Credit rationing.
qe: What is 'Repo Rate' vs 'Bank Rate' in RBI's monetary policy operations?
oe: Repo Rate is for short-term collateralized lending; Bank Rate is for long-term/penal non-collateralized lending
Repo Rate is set by SEBI; Bank Rate is set by Finance Ministry
Bank Rate is always lower than Reverse Repo Rate
Repo Rate applies only to agricultural loans

q: कंप्यूटर शब्दावली में 'HTTP' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है, और 'HTTPS' कौन-सी अतिरिक्त सुविधा प्रदान करता है?
o: HyperText Transfer Protocol; Encrypted secure communication (SSL/TLS)
High-Speed Transmission Process; Faster broadband download
Hyperlink Text Tracking Program; Automated pop-up blocking
Host Terminal Transfer Protocol; Offline file storage
e:
HTTP stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol; HTTPS adds SSL/TLS encryption to secure data exchanged between browser and web server (HTTPS, SSL/TLS एन्क्रिप्शन द्वारा सुरक्षित संचार प्रदान करता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Standard port for HTTP is 80; for HTTPS is 443.
2. Firewall monitors and filters incoming/outgoing network traffic based on security rules.
3. Malware types: Virus, Worm (self-replicating without host file), Trojan Horse (disguised legitimate software), Ransomware (encrypts files for ransom).
qe: In computer terminology, what does 'HTTP' stand for, and what additional feature does 'HTTPS' provide?
oe: HyperText Transfer Protocol; Encrypted secure communication (SSL/TLS)
High-Speed Transmission Process; Faster broadband download
Hyperlink Text Tracking Program; Automated pop-up blocking
Host Terminal Transfer Protocol; Offline file storage

q:
अक्टूबर–नवंबर 2026 की सत्यापित भारतीय घटनाओं के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारत विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा मछली व जलीय कृषि उत्पादक है, जिसमें MPEDA समुद्री निर्यात तथा APEDA कृषि व प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य निर्यात को बढ़ावा देता है।
कथन II: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारतीय नौसेना की ब्रह्मोस मिसाइल प्रणाली के लिए ₹661.50 करोड़ का अनुबंध हस्ताक्षरित हुआ।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are verified October–November 2026 facts (दोनों कथन पूर्णतः सत्य हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. In October 2026, Peptris also received ₹86 crore support for AI-Based Drug Discovery, and ICAR-IIAB opened new facilities in Ranchi.
2. In October 2026, 28 locations in Ladakh were marked on the Survey of India map and 5 projects worth ₹3,350 crore were inaugurated.
3. MPEDA HQ: Kochi (Kerala); APEDA HQ: New Delhi.
qe:
Consider the following two statements based on verified October–November 2026 Indian developments:
Statement I: India is the world's second-largest fish and aquaculture producer, with MPEDA promoting marine exports and APEDA promoting agricultural and processed food exports.
Statement II: A ₹661.50 crore contract was signed in October 2026 for the Indian Navy's BrahMos missile system.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q:

q:
भारतीय शिक्षा के इतिहास की निम्नलिखित प्रमुख घटनाओं के सही वर्षों का क्रम कौन-सा है?
1. शिक्षा के लिए प्रतिवर्ष ₹1 लाख आवंटित करने वाला चार्टर अधिनियम
2. अंग्रेजी शिक्षा पर मैकाले का मिनट
3. वुड्स डिस्पैच ('भारतीय शिक्षा का मैग्ना कार्टा')
4. हंटर शिक्षा आयोग
e:
Exact chronological years: Charter Act of 1813 → Macaulay's Minute (1835) → Wood's Despatch (1854) → Hunter Commission (1882) (1813, 1835, 1854, 1882)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Later milestones: Indian Universities Act (1904) → Sadler Commission (1917) → Hartog Committee (1929) → Wardha Scheme (1937) → Sargent Plan (1944).
2. Post-independence: Radhakrishnan (1948–49) → Mudaliar (1952–53) → Kothari (1964–66) → NPE 1968 → NPE 1986 → NEP 2020.
3. Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras Universities were established in 1857 following Wood's Despatch.
qe:
Consider the following chronological sequence of major milestones in Indian Educational History:
1. Charter Act allocating ₹1 lakh annually for education
2. Macaulay's Minute on English Education
3. Wood's Despatch ('Magna Carta of Indian Education')
4. Hunter Education Commission
Which of the following gives their exact years in order?

q: अहमदनगर किले में कारावास (1942–45) के दौरान लिखी गई 'द डिस्कवरी ऑफ इंडिया' और 'ग्लिम्प्सेस ऑफ वर्ल्ड हिस्ट्री' के लेखक कौन थे?
e:
Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru authored 'The Discovery of India', 'Glimpses of World History', and 'An Autobiography' ('Toward Freedom') (जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने डिस्कवरी ऑफ इंडिया लिखी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Maulana Abul Kalam Azad wrote 'India Wins Freedom'; Dr. Rajendra Prasad wrote 'India Divided'.
2. Mahatma Gandhi wrote 'Hind Swaraj' (1909) and 'The Story of My Experiments with Truth'.
3. Subhas Chandra Bose wrote 'The Indian Struggle'; Lala Lajpat Rai wrote 'Unhappy India'.
qe: Who was the author of 'The Discovery of India' (written during his imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort in 1942–45) and 'Glimpses of World History'?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने अनुच्छेद 15(6) और 16(6) के माध्यम से आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों (EWS) के लिए 10% आरक्षण का प्रावधान किया?
e:
The 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019 inserted Articles 15(6) and 16(6) providing up to 10% EWS reservation in educational institutions and public employment (upheld by SC in Janhit Abhiyan v. Union of India, 2022) (103वें संशोधन 2019 द्वारा 10% EWS आरक्षण जोड़ा गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. 104th Amendment (2020) extended SC/ST reservation in Lok Sabha/Assemblies for 10 years and discontinued Anglo-Indian nominated seats.
2. 105th Amendment (2021) restored states' power to identify SEBCs/OBCs.
3. 106th Amendment (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023) provides 33% reservation for women in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies.
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added Article 371J (special provisions for Hyderabad-Karnataka region) AND which Amendment Act introduced 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) via Articles 15(6) and 16(6)?

q: भारतीय संविधान में मौलिक अधिकारों का उल्लंघन करने वाले कानूनों के 'न्यायिक पुनरावलोकन' (Judicial Review) की शक्ति स्पष्ट रूप से किस अनुच्छेद में निहित है?
e:
Article 13(1) and 13(2) declare all pre-constitutional and post-constitutional laws inconsistent with Fundamental Rights to be void to the extent of inconsistency, forming the explicit constitutional anchor of Judicial Review (अनुच्छेद 13 न्यायिक पुनरावलोकन का स्पष्ट संवैधानिक आधार है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Note that the exact phrase 'Judicial Review' is NOT used verbatim in the Constitution, though Articles 13, 32, 131–136, 226, and 246 embody it.
2. In L. Chandra Kumar v. Union of India (1997), the Supreme Court held Judicial Review under Articles 32 and 226 to be part of the Basic Structure.
3. Judicial Activism and PIL (Public Interest Litigation) were pioneered in India by Justices P. N. Bhagwati and V. R. Krishna Iyer.
qe: In the Constitution of India, the power of 'Judicial Review' of laws violating Fundamental Rights is explicitly grounded in which Article?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप समूह में स्थित है तथा यूनेस्को के विश्व बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व नेटवर्क (WNBR) का हिस्सा है?
e:
Great Nicobar Biosphere Reserve (covering Campbell Bay & Galathea National Parks, home to Shompen tribe and Nicobar Megapode) joined UNESCO's WNBR in 2013 (ग्रेट निकोबार बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व अंडमान व निकोबार में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Gulf of Mannar (Tamil Nadu) is India's first marine biosphere reserve (in WNBR since 2001).
2. Achanakmar-Amarkantak spans Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh (in WNBR since 2012).
3. Indira Point (southernmost tip of India, 6°45' N) is located at the southern end of Great Nicobar Island.
qe: Which of the following Biosphere Reserves is located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and is part of UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves?

q: समष्टि आर्थिक विश्लेषण में 'जीडीपी अवस्फीतिकारक' (GDP Deflator) क्या मापता है?
o: Ratio of Nominal GDP to Real GDP multiplied by 100 (broadest measure of economy-wide inflation)
Ratio of Fiscal Deficit to Total Tax Revenue
Ratio of Imports to Exports in constant prices
Annual percentage change in Repo Rate
e:
GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP ÷ Real GDP) × 100. Unlike CPI (fixed consumer basket), GDP Deflator covers ALL domestically produced final goods and services (नाममात्र GDP और वास्तविक GDP का अनुपात × 100 = GDP डिफ्लेटर)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Real GDP is calculated at constant base-year prices (adjusted for inflation), while Nominal GDP is at current market prices.
2. CPI (Consumer Price Index) is published by NSO (MoSPI) and is RBI's nominal anchor for inflation targeting (4% ± 2%).
3. WPI (Wholesale Price Index) is published by the Office of Economic Adviser (Ministry of Commerce & Industry) and excludes services.
qe: In macroeconomic analysis, what does 'GDP Deflator' measure?
oe: Ratio of Nominal GDP to Real GDP multiplied by 100 (broadest measure of economy-wide inflation)
Ratio of Fiscal Deficit to Total Tax Revenue
Ratio of Imports to Exports in constant prices
Annual percentage change in Repo Rate

q: नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता कौन-सी जीन-संपादन तकनीक DNA में सटीक संशोधन करने के लिए गाइड RNA और Cas9 एंजाइम का उपयोग कर 'आणविक कैंची' के रूप में कार्य करती है?
e:
CRISPR-Cas9 (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats; 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry to Emmanuelle Charpentier and Jennifer Doudna) enables precise DNA editing (CRISPR-Cas9 आणविक कैंची के रूप में कार्य करती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. PCR (invented by Kary Mullis, 1993 Nobel) amplifies tiny DNA segments exponentially (used in RT-PCR testing).
2. DNA double-helix structure was elucidated by James Watson and Francis Crick (1953, with Rosalind Franklin's X-ray data).
3. Human cells contain 46 chromosomes (23 pairs: 22 pairs of autosomes + 1 pair of sex chromosomes XX/XY).
qe: Which Nobel-prize-winning gene-editing technology acts as 'molecular scissors' using guide RNA and the Cas9 enzyme to make precise edits in DNA?
